## Context

What problem exists now? Which accepted rules constrain this decision? Why decide at this stage?

## Alternatives considered

Option A / Option B / Option C; operational, security, maintenance, portability and implementation cost trade-offs.

## Decision

Write an unambiguous statement, only after explicit approval. While proposed, write "Proposed decision".

## Consequences

Benefits, disadvantages, data/API/security impact, rollback and migration implications.

## Scope and non-goals

What this decision does **not** authorize or imply.

## Approval evidence

Date, quoted decision or conversation/PR location; if absent, remain PROPOSED.
